units.source_text: 窸窸窣窣，有什么虫在脚背上爬……

en.t: Rustling and scratching, some kind of insect was crawling over the top of his foot...

units.source_text: 要是斑蝥一族的话不会有这样的爬行方法……

en.t: If it were one of the blister beetles, it would not crawl in that way...

units.source_text: 肯定是步行虫一类，瘦弱的六条脚好不容易拖动体重……

en.t: It had to be some kind of ground beetle, its six frail legs barely dragging its body along...

units.source_text: 男人连确认一下的心思也没有。

en.t: The man did not even feel like checking.

units.source_text: 他甚至怀疑，假如那虫真是斑蝥，自己会不会跟上去。

en.t: He even wondered whether, if the insect really were a blister beetle, he would follow it.

units.source_text: 恐怕他自己也作不出肯定的回答。

en.t: Most likely, even he himself could not give a definite answer.
